chat_enabled.description: Continue or safely fork OMP sessions, or start full sessions in any supported installed harness from the Agentik panel and optional desktop widget.
chat_enabled.label: Enable coding session chat

display_label.description: What to show as the primary label for each session in the panel: the project directory, the agent-chosen session name, or the active model (name only, without the provider).
display_label.label: Primary label

excluded_projects.description: Comma-separated project directory names or full paths to omit from Agentik monitoring and chat.
excluded_projects.label: Excluded projects

filter_attention.description: Show only sessions that are waiting or blocked.
filter_attention.label: Needs attention only

high_contrast.description: Use stronger session backgrounds and primary text contrast.
high_contrast.label: Increase contrast

notification_cooldown_seconds.description: Minimum time between Agentik attention notifications.
notification_cooldown_seconds.label: Notification cooldown (seconds)

notification_privacy.description: Keep notification bodies free of project and task names; show only the attention state.
notification_privacy.label: Privacy notifications

notify_attention.description: Notify only when a known active agent changes to waiting or blocked. Disabled by default.
notify_attention.label: Notify on attention needed

presentation_mode.description: Slow orb motion and session rotation, show longer labels, and use high-contrast presentation styling.
presentation_mode.label: Presentation mode

reduce_motion.description: Use static orb frames and reveal live assistant text immediately.
reduce_motion.label: Reduce motion

show_attention.description: Show the active, waiting, or blocked state beside each session in the panel.
show_attention.label: Show attention state

show_count.description: Show the ordinal number of the active agent currently displayed by this bar widget.
show_count.label: Show displayed-agent number

show_intent.description: Show the state inferred from active OMP agents' current tool intents in the bar.
show_intent.label: Show intent state

show_task.description: Show the current OMP todo item for each session in the panel.
show_task.label: Show current task

sort_mode.description: Order panel sessions by running time or attention-first (blocked, then waiting).
sort_mode.label: Sort order

ui.attachments_unavailable: Attachments are not supported by this session
ui.attention_open_session_help: Open the owning session. Terminal-owned sessions remain read-only here.
ui.chat_empty: Send a message to this full coding session. Its harness-native tools, rules, skills, extensions, model, and history are active.
ui.chat_error: Coding session bridge returned an invalid response
ui.chat_picker_help: Continue a finished OMP session, safely fork one that is active elsewhere, or choose an installed harness and model for a new project session.
ui.chat_terminal_active: Terminal owns this session. Conversation refreshes here; exit the terminal before replying in this panel.
ui.copy_proposal_help: Copy “{choice}” only; paste it in the owning session to respond. Nothing is sent or approved here.
ui.health_not_ready: No supported coding-agent harness is available
ui.monitor_error: Monitoring failed — displayed sessions may be outdated
ui.monitor_stale: Monitoring stale — displayed sessions may be outdated
ui.recent_activity_read_only: Read-only recent activity. No response or approval is sent from this view.
ui.recent_outcomes_empty: No recent completed, failed, or cancelled sessions.
ui.recent_outcomes_retention: Latest 8 outcomes from the last 10 minutes. Transcripts are read-only.
